title: Studying with Murray Deutsch; freedom in Dixieland; the stolen trunk
summary: He studied Schillinger and Hindemith-type systems with a teacher and found Dixieland a free place to experiment, and lost his study books when his trunk was stolen in France.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Bebop was -- they was struggling then. at Minton's and They were/ getting paid off and I imagine, not a great sum of money because the clientele wouldn't have paid that much money so, I was doing -- and, by the way, I was studying with with a man named Murray (Deutschmanic), now, he had a method
of his own, it was great, it was greater than Schillingberg, Schillingberg's method.
Schillinger, yeah, and Hindenberg, he had them all mixed together. This man was a genius. I was studying with him and --
Yeah, Hindemith -- I got to get them all -- got to get them straight.
Hindenberg -- how did he get in there? So, this is where I learned all this strata harmony and more music and script writing.
You were studying this while you were in -- in the '40's when --
Oh, yes, yes, I'm always studying something.
But now, what were your, given the fact that your, what use could you make of that kind of study? a in/ Dixieland context?

Dixieland -- when you play Dixieland, it's free, you play anything that you want to play and so you put some of that in there. As Duke was saying, he picked the pretty notes -- don't care, you pick those pretty notes. So, that's what I did and I was in there trying, I was
experimenting and Dixieland was free and I stayed around the melody and you had a chance to do it.

So, that's what I was doing -- and then, I always knew that one day I'd be writing music. I knew that. So, I just studied because there was nothing else to do. Just studied and what happened, I regret that I lost some of my study books.

I had a big study book, they stole my whole trunk, in France, just stole my whole trunk, my mother's picture and all my stuff that's old, you know? Just stole that, and I lost it, I'll never get that again.
